products.product_description: Field Day Organic Ranch Dressing packaged in an 8 fl. oz. glass bottle, UPC #042563600242. The lot code is located on the back of the bottle above the label. Specifically, the front label of the affected product is correctly labeled Field Day Organic Ranch Dressing, 8 fl oz. The issue is some bottles have an incorrect back label such that the contains statement does not list milk and egg as allergens. These bottles can be identified by UPC# 042563600259.
